|game_text=Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. [Vader] cards never deploy unless [[Rise Of The Dark Lord]] on table. Once per turn, if at a site you control, may apply his ability to draw battle destiny elsewhere. Immune to [[Clash Of Sabers]] and attrition < 5. May not be [[Disarmed]].
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of [[Darth Vader, More Machine Than Man]], the text of the PC website card list. Other versions: [[Darth Vader, More Machine Than Man]] (original), [[Darth Vader, More Machine Than Man (Errata)]] (PC-E1), [[Darth Vader, More Machine Than Man (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3) and [[Darth Vader, More Machine Than Man (Errata 4)]] (PC-E4, the current text). No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB7-01-Darth_Vader_More_Machine_Than_Man-PC-E2-cardmaker.png]]; renamed on 11 November 2026 when the versions were put in date order). How these versions came about (Holotable data, the PC website card list, the Master List and the PC card images) is told in [[PC Legacy Virtual Transcription Error History]].
* '''Original''' ([[Darth Vader, More Machine Than Man]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet (official text as of 18 June 2010): “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. [Vader] cards never deploy unless Rise Of The Dark Lord on table. Once per turn, if at a site you control, may apply his ability to draw battle destiny elsewhere. Immune to Clash Of Sabers, Disarmed, and attrition < 5.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 18 June 2010"; copy re-made 28 July 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174512/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The slip prints the pilot icon with “3.” (written out here as “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots.”) and the [Vader] icon.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Darth Vader, More Machine Than Man (Errata)]]): The Players Committee posted this errata on its rules forum on 21 March 2011, as an addition to Appendix A of the Advanced Rulebook<ref name="pcforum-p608385">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=48201, now titled “Current Rulings Archive July 2010 - August 2012”), post by Aglets, 21 March 2011 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=48201&start=20#p608385 forum post]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261111155609/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t48201-start20.html#p608385 Internet Archive]</ref>. It took “Disarmed” out of the immunity list and added “May not be Disarmed.” in front of the immunity: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. [Vader] cards never deploy unless Rise Of The Dark Lord on table. Once per turn, if at a site you control, may apply his ability to draw battle destiny elsewhere. May not be Disarmed. Immune to Clash Of Sabers and attrition < 5.”
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) moved “May not be Disarmed.” to the end, after the immunity; no word changed: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. [Vader] cards never deploy unless Rise Of The Dark Lord on table. Once per turn, if at a site you control, may apply his ability to draw battle destiny elsewhere. Immune to Clash Of Sabers and attrition < 5. May not be Disarmed.”<ref name="cl-1271_2-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Darth Vader, More Machine Than Man (Errata 3)]]): The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-darthvadermoremachinethanman-pre.gif]], marked E; on the Players Committee's server by 25 February 2013<ref name="pc-img-date">The Players Committee's Legacy card image folders for Virtual Blocks 1–7 carry one bulk web-server upload date, 25 February 2013 (for example the Virtual Block 7 Light Side folder, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034736/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/?C=M;O=A 18 August 2019], Internet Archive); the Dark Side folder listing was not archived.</ref>): “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. [Vader] cards never deploy unless Rise Of The Dark Lord on table. Once per turn, if at a site you control, may apply his ability to draw battle destiny elsewhere. May not be Disarmed. Immune to Clash Of Sabers and attrition < 5.” It prints the PC-E1 forum text again, word for word. A Players Committee card image is a version of its own, placed at its date, even when its words repeat an earlier version (versions ruling of 11 November 2026, 09:14). Its date is the folder's bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; the version order follows that date (versions ruling of 11 November 2026, 08:45). The card image shows the card's art, prints the errata mark E bottom right and no slip number.
* '''PC-E4''' ([[Darth Vader, More Machine Than Man (Errata 4)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 7)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> prints the PC-E1 forum text again, word for word: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. [Vader] cards never deploy unless Rise Of The Dark Lord on table. Once per turn, if at a site you control, may apply his ability to draw battle destiny elsewhere. May not be Disarmed. Immune to Clash Of Sabers and attrition < 5.” Every published text is a version, even a word-for-word repeat (versions ruling of 11 November 2026), so the Master List is listed as PC-E4. It is the last published text, so it is the current text. The Master List slip leaves the art box blank and prints neither a slip number nor an errata mark.
